g.text: Predict the next basket using previously purchased products [1]
Disjoint users: 20,000 training, 5,000 validation, 8,000 confirmation; none used in earlier experiments.
Recall@10 = hits / all repeat targets, averaged over 7,472 users; 528 have no repeat targets and undefined recall. Targets and users stay fixed.

g.text: Intervals: 12 posthoc comparisons; six tested K values. No new fitting or
of excluded true targets were in the original
were ranked after position 20 by the full model.
The value of older products depends on scoring and recommendation length. Short-list retention does not make excluded demand unimportant.
First-time purchases excluded. Full history retained; no measured runtime/storage gain or causal claim. Seed metrics averaged per user, not scores.
Primary contrasts: user-paired bootstrap, 6,000 draws, simultaneous 95% across 9 contrasts. Posthoc K contrasts use a separate family of 12.
[1] Instacart (2017), Kaggle / Yasser H. mirror. [2] Ke et al., LightGBM (NeurIPS 2017). Context: Hu et al. (SIGIR 2020); Li et al., Reality Check (2023).
